scope: Actual Three renderer using shipped v007/v008 assets and default appearance profiles; original v005 PNG displayed separately as a labelled still reference. Selected animation/controller inputs, actual pointer events, and real frame progress. This is no live voice/provider/native-window or automatic-state integration claim. No image edits, overridden mixer clock, camera, pose, shader or material.
limitations: Blink/click stills sample wall time, not an exact closed-eye or bounce peak; inspect the recorded moving sequence and separate actual-GLB replay. Multiple canvases/video are not single-avatar performance measurements.
